analysis: The trial executed successfully but reduced host macro validation HR@10 to 0.5613 versus the prior 0.5737, a decline of 0.0124 (1.24 percentage points). Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.605, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.625, Electronics 0.415, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.600. Electronics declined from the reported prior 0.435. These results do not support adding two-step supervision at weight 0.25 in this configuration; competing next-item and two-step objectives are a possible explanation, not an established cause. Allocated GPU time was 278.70 seconds. No test metrics were available.
code_summary: One independent GRURec per category: 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, input LayerNorm, two-layer GRU, dropout 0.25, linear projection with LayerNorm, normalized dot-product scoring with learned scale and item bias. Training retains the primary eight-negative softplus objective and adds weight-0.25 two-step softplus supervision using shifted targets within each sampled training window. Both objectives share encoder states and scoring parameters; auxiliary negatives use a separate RNG. AdamW, seed 42, default 200 epochs, and 25-epoch patience are retained. Each category selects and strictly reloads one checkpoint by validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 tie-breaking. Prediction routes to that single category model; no ensemble or auxiliary inference head is used.
